import os
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p),exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    # Separator rows/columns are the most frequent divider color.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    div = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    sep_rows = [r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == div for v in row)]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == div for r in range(h))]
    rparts=[]; start=0
    for r in sep_rows+[h]:
        if r>start: rparts.append((start,r))
        start=r+1
    cparts=[]; start=0
    for c in sep_cols+[w]:
        if c>start: cparts.append((start,c))
        start=c+1
    # Each tile is encoded by its count of non-background cells; singleton anomalies are 2, double anomalies 1.
    bg=max(set(v for row in grid for v in row if v != div), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    return [[1 if sum(grid[r][c] != bg for r in range(a,b) for c in range(x,y)) == 2 else 2 for x,y in cparts] for a,b in rparts]
'''
